name: bulk-rail-loaders-pooled-plus
title: Bulk Rail Loaders: Pooled Plus
author: tarioch, Sølve Monteiro
description: Bulk train loading/unloading silos that share a single pooled inventory per station. Contents can never get unbalanced between wagons, so automated deliveries (e.g. Cybersyn) always complete when the station total suffices. Fork of Modern Bulk Rail Loaders: Pooled by Sølve Monteiro for Factorio 2.1, with exact loading for Cybersyn 2 deliveries and reworked graphics.
